title: The Worthwhile task for the pupils
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：worthwhile　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 worthwhile 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the grower wrote of ① a worthwhile task for the pupils in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so worthwhile that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the worthwhile ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the worthwhile task for the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too worthwhile to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the worthwhile ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a worthwhile cause for the family, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as worthwhile as the cause for the family they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was worthwhile or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something worthwhile, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite worthwhile; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the worthwhile ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, before dawn, she wrote of another worthwhile task for the pupils in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less worthwhile than anybody had expected. ⑩ The worthwhile cause for the family that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the worthwhile ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 值得做（前置定语 a worthwhile task for the pupils：1985 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件值得做的工作）
B. adj. 值得做／有意义（两处加强说法：so worthwhile that … 与 no less worthwhile than …）
C. adj. 值得做／有意义（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 值得做（表语 too worthwhile to do：母亲觉得它太值得做，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有意义（前置定语 a worthwhile cause for the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有意义的事业）
F. adj. 有意义（同级比较 as worthwhile as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩全家值得为之付出的事业相比）
G. adj. 有意义（后置定语 something worthwhile：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有意义（受程度副词修饰 quite worthwhile：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a worthwhile task for the pupils
the worthwhile task for the pupils that
a worthwhile cause for the family
The worthwhile cause for the family that

answers.why: worthwhile 意为“值得做”，1985 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件值得做的工作”，此处作前置定语 a worthwhile task for the pupils。
worthwhile 意为“值得做”，此处用 so worthwhile that 结构，说它值得做到大棚里没人敢靠近。
worthwhile 意为“值得做”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的值得做值得让学生做的工作，等于最高级的说法。
worthwhile 意为“值得做”，母亲认为这件东西“太值得做了，谁也用不上”，too worthwhile to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有意义的事业”，此处作前置定语 a worthwhile cause for the family。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩全家值得为之付出的事业一样有意义”，同级比较用 as worthwhile as。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，收成账上那半行字要的是“有意义的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something worthwhile。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当有意义”，quite 修饰原级 worthwhile。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，no less worthwhile than 表示“其有意义不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之有意义不亚于任何人的预料。
worthwhile 意为“有意义”，母亲 1997 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的有意义事业”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件值得做的工作。（a worthwhile task for the pupils）
它值得做到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so worthwhile that …）
母亲觉得它太值得做，谁也用不上。（too worthwhile to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有意义的事业。（a worthwhile cause for the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩全家值得为之付出的事业一样有意义。（as worthwhile as …）
到了 1992 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件有意义的东西。（something worthwhile）
answers: In 1985 the grower wrote of a worthwhile task for the pupils in the ledger.
It was so worthwhile that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too worthwhile to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a worthwhile cause for the family.
He said nobody would call it as worthwhile as the cause for the family they had once had.
By 1992 the ledger asked for nothing but something worthwhile.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 worthwhile 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the grower wrote of a worthwhile task for the pupils in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the worthwhile task for the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too worthwhile to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a worthwhile cause for the family, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite worthwhile, and everybody laughed.
The worthwhile ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
